{{Top|leg}}
'''G-021''', also referred to as '''fleet gig 021''', was one of many [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] personnel transports used to ferry [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] between the ships of the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Battle Group]]. [[Plat Mallar]] was in charge of the craft, which he used to ferry [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bowman Gavin]] to the ''[[Polaron]]''.
